about.title: Mendota Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Mendota sits on the west side of Fresno County, a community of about 11,430 people where most families know one another by name. That closeness makes a sudden death harder to carry, and it also means the practical questions arrive quickly: who covers the funeral, how the household replaces a lost paycheck, what the family can do when someone else's carelessness caused the loss. Public records for 2025 show 12 injury collisions and 16 people hurt on Mendota's roads, with no traffic fatalities recorded that year; collision reports concentrate along Oller Street, Derrick Avenue, Route 33 and Route 180, and tend to cluster on Sunday evenings between 6 and 8 p.m. Yet a wrongful death claim is not limited to car crashes. Farm equipment incidents, workplace hazards, unsafe premises and medical errors can all lead to a civil action. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that matches Mendota families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Mendota Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can explain where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected promptly protects that timeline.

items.title: Every recognized loss accounted for
items.desc: Recoverable losses under California law include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Independent counsel works to document each one, on contingency.

items.question: Mendota recorded zero traffic deaths in 2025. Do wrongful death claims still happen here?
items.answer: They do. Road fatalities are only one path to a wrongful death claim, and a small town's yearly count can change from one year to the next. Losses connected to farm work, unsafe premises, medical care or a defective product can also give rise to a civil action. If a death in your family was caused by someone else's negligence, it is worth asking an attorney whether a claim exists.

items.question: The driver who caused the death is facing criminal charges. Do we still need to file anything?
items.answer: Yes, if your family wants to recover losses. A criminal case is brought by the state and focuses on punishment; it does not compensate the family. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, and it can proceed regardless of how the criminal matter turns out.

items.question: Does it cost anything to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, which means there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You can ask questions and decide at your own pace.
